title: Addition-site label assignment
statement: Define a map from addition sites to labels as follows. For an index site $(k,j)$, assign the label indexed by $k$ with subscript $2$ when $j=0$, with subscript $8$ when $j=1$, and the example label assigned to $k$ when $j=2$. The five sites indexed by $j=0,1,2,3,4$ map respectively to $	ext{lc}_1$, $	ext{lc}_2$, $	ext{lc}_3$, $	ext{lc}_4$, and $	ext{mc}_{m_0}$; the doubling site maps to $c_3$.
